title: Read-only missing accessible name on form controls
description:
# Read-only missing accessible name on form controls

Next slice of LIM-e872b1. Extends `limatus usability scan` only. No layout engine.

## DoD

- Same CLI. New kind: `missing_accessible_name`.
- Profile: `accessibleName.flagMissing` boolean, default **true**. Unknown keys rejected. Existing contrast / tapTarget / focus profiles still load.
- When `flagMissing` is false, never emit this kind.
- Elements: `input` except `type=hidden`, `select`, `textarea`. Also `input type=image` with no alt/aria-label (alt counts as the name). Do **not** flag `button` that has non-whitespace text, or `input type=submit|button|reset` that has a non-empty `value` or `aria-label`.
- An accessible name exists if **any** of: non-empty `aria-label`; non-empty `aria-labelledby` id that matches an element in the page; a wrapping `<label>`; a `<label for="id">` pointing at this control’s `id`; for `input type=image`, a non-empty `alt`.
- `title` alone is **not** a name (too weak).
- JSON: `id`, `kind`, `selector`, `rationale`. Other kinds unchanged.
- Tests (tempfile HTML, not fixture-dir junk):
  - `<input type="text">` with no label → flags
  - `<label>Name <input type="text"></label>` → no this kind
  - `<label for="n">N</label><input id="n">` → no this kind
  - `aria-label="Name"` → no this kind
  - existing both-findings.html / minimal.html do not gain this kind
- `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q`

## Out of scope

- Placeholder-as-label, title, decide/apply, SKILL.md, live URLs, contrast/tap/focus regressions

## Layout

- Worktree: `/tmp/limatus-e872b1-accessible-name` from `origin/main`
- Branch: `feat/LIM-<this-id>-usability-accessible-name`
- PR target: **main**

## Inversion

- Do not flag a properly labelled control.
- Do not treat placeholder or title as a name.
